news.title: New major risk - Financial position
news.body: The company's debt is not well covered by operating cash flow. Operating cash flow to total debt ratio: 11% This is considered a major risk. If the company's operating cash flows are too small relative to the size of their debt, it increases their balance sheet risk. The company has less cash from operations to cover its expenses from servicing large debt and it increases the risk of liquidity issues. It also extends the time it would take for the company to pay back the debt in full, meaning it may not be able to easily pay it all off in a distress scenario. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risk Debt is not well covered by operating cash flow (11% operating cash flow to total debt). news.title: Full year 2026 earnings: EPS exceeds analyst expectations
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹77.90 (up from ₹7.19 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹27.8b (up 11% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹10.9b (up ₹9.94b from FY 2025). Revenue is forecast to grow 38% p.a. on average during the next 2 years, compared to a 22% growth forecast for the Real Estate industry in India.

news.title: New major risk - Revenue and earnings growth
news.body: Earnings are forecast to decline by an average of 7.9% per year for the foreseeable future. This is considered a major risk. Ultimately, shareholders want to see a good return on their investment and that generally comes from sharing in the company's profits. If profits are expected to decline, then in most cases the share price will decline over time as well. In addition, if the company pays dividends it will also likely need to reduce or cut them, striking a dual blow to total shareholder returns. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risks Earnings are forecast to decline by an average of 7.9% per year for the foreseeable future. High level of non-cash earnings (54% accrual ratio).

news.title: Millennia Realtors Private Limited agreed to acquire an unknown minority stake in Gurugram Commercity Private Limited from Signatureglobal (India) Limited (NSEI:SIGNATURE).
news.body:
Millennia Realtors Private Limited agreed to acquire an unknown minority stake in Gurugram Commercity Private Limited from Signatureglobal (India) Limited (NSEI:SIGNATURE) on February 14, 2026. A cash consideration will be paid by Millennia Realtors Private Limited. As part of consideration, an undisclosed value is paid towards common equity of Gurugram Commercity Private Limited.

For the period ending March 31, 2025, Gurugram Commercity Private Limited reported total revenue of INR 0.04 million. As of March 31, 2025, Gurugram Commercity Private Limited reported total common equity of INR 571.42 million.

The transaction is subject to approval of merger agreement by target board. The deal has been approved by the board. The expected completion of the transaction is March 23, 2026.

news.body: The company has large one-off items impacting its financial results. One-off items were 45% of the size of the rest of the company's trailing 12-month earnings before tax. This is considered a minor risk. One-off items are incomes or expenses that the company does not expect to repeat in future periods. Examples include profits from the sale of a business or expenses from a restructuring or legal settlements. If the company's reported statutory earnings include a large proportion of one-off items it means they may be an unreliable indicator of its true business performance as the earnings were skewed by these incomes or expenses.
